title: Present portfolio runs as decision-first action briefs

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Feature: Decision-first optimization portfolio reports

  Scenario: A run launches no optimizers because diagnosis coverage is capped
    Given exhaustive ranking and assessment are complete
    And some diagnosis candidates were deferred by a safety cap
    When the living Report reaches its decision milestone
    Then the first screen states that no optimizers launched
    And distinguishes diagnosed, deferred, selected, launched, and launch-rejected counts
    And recommends the next bounded operator action

  Scenario: Human actions are separated from exhaustive evidence
    Given a portfolio contains repair, stakeholder, collection, cooldown, and monitoring findings
    When an operator opens the Report
    Then actionable findings are aggregated by owner and required decision
    And the exhaustive score inventory is collapsed behind an evidence explorer
    And every aggregate links to its filtered supporting rows

  Scenario: Deferred diagnosis is not presented as approved execution
    Given a score passed deterministic assessment but semantic diagnosis was deferred
    When the Report derives its next action
    Then the action requests completion of diagnosis
    And the score is not labeled approved or ready to optimize

  Scenario: Non-candidates are not launch rejections
    Given assessed scores do not satisfy optimization readiness policy
    When execution evidence is summarized
    Then ordinary non-candidates are counted separately from targets rejected during launch-time freshness checks

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Dogfood reproduction confirmed the Report presented an exhaustive inventory as an action queue, conflated policy non-selection with launch rejection, and allowed missing semantic diagnosis to retain a premature execution action. Added failing behavior tests, implemented a decision-first outcome card and grouped workstreams, capped representative action evidence at 25 rows, and changed missing-diagnosis projection to request diagnosis instead of execution. Validation: 235 focused Python tests passed; 30 dashboard component tests passed; dashboard typecheck passed; Python flake8 passed. Direct ESLint invocation is currently blocked by the repository AJV configuration under the active Node runtime and will be rerun through the supported Node 20 CI path.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Live follow-up observation found that a zero-launch decision could render during initial ranking because launch count is naturally zero before diagnosis. Added a terminal-or-diagnosis-evidence gate and regression coverage so the decision card appears only when a decision can honestly be stated. Dashboard component tests now pass 31/31 and Node typecheck passes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Feature: Decision-first optimization reports

Scenario: Analysis has not reached a decision
  Given portfolio assessment or diagnosis is still pending
  When an operator opens the living Report
  Then the conclusion states that no optimization decision exists yet
  And zero selected or launched targets are not presented as a terminal outcome

Scenario: Shared findings become one open workstream
  Given multiple scores share the same canonical next action and dominant issue
  When the stakeholder presentation is published
  Then each score contributes to exactly one primary workstream
  And workstream counts reconcile to the underlying scores
  And affected scorecards and scores remain expandable

Scenario: Realtime evidence refreshes during operator review
  Given an operator has expanded workstreams and scrolled into the Report
  When a newer Report revision arrives
  Then compatible expansion and filter state are preserved
  And the viewport does not jump because unrelated content re-rendered

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started after baseline dogfood observation. The existing run assessed the full eligible portfolio and scheduled bounded diagnosis, but repeated a 549-artifact publication batch before computation could advance. Backend behavior specs now fail/pass for deterministic mutually exclusive workstreams and provisional decision summaries. Dashboard and core-publication changes are in progress; no additional run, deployment, push, or promotion has occurred.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Decision-first dashboard implementation now leads with the backend conclusion, renders exactly four score-count cards, groups open workstreams by next action, and keeps monitor/history reachable through a persistent status filter. Compatible realtime rerenders preserve component state and no longer clear the last committed presentation while a new artifact loads. Focused dashboard tests and full typecheck pass. No client-specific information is recorded here.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation validation update: the stakeholder presentation now leads with a backend-authored conclusion, reconciled mutually exclusive score workstreams, four aggregate action cards, and Open/Monitor/History progressive disclosure. Visual acceptance found and corrected an internally inconsistent demo fixture so its 12 score assignments, five workstreams, execution funnel, and validated outcome reconcile. Focused backend tests: 103 passed. Focused dashboard tests: 33 passed. Storybook Chromium: 91 suites and 704 tests passed. Python 3.11 and 3.12 full suites, dashboard coverage/typecheck, and Tactus regression are green. The existing bounded pilot remains nonterminal in its legacy report-publication retry loop; no new pilot has been started.
